reason: The Standard archive reuses the previous tree meshes and does not satisfy the requested Farthest Frontier visual direction.
submitted_candidate: Poly Haven CC0 Tree Scans (GOPALA LOD pass) - 16 variants
submission_note: Sixteen single-surface variants derived by decimating six CC0 Poly Haven photogrammetry scans to at most 6687 triangles each and baking each into one atlas material, because Godot MultiMesh renders surface 0 only. The hash-pinned submitted bake remains visible in the running scene while human review of reports/kathmandu-forest.png and reports/kathmandu-trees.png is pending; acceptance is still withheld until accepted_bake_sha256 is set.
acceptance: A genuinely different externally authored tree family, complete materials, physical scale, terrain placement, management-camera visual review and measured rendering cost. No self-modelled trees.
